planets.name: Kepler-90 f
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-90 with a 125-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-90 f was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Cabrera et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: Kepler-90f
quotes.card: Kepler-90f is an exoplanet orbiting the star Kepler-90, located in the constellation Draco.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered by the Kepler telescope in October 2013.
